_note: LoRAs by name. These four are built in (see docs/models.md); your own go in models/loras/ and are used the same way (see configs/your-files/). A built-in LoRA's trigger word is added to the prompt for you; `trigger` sets it for any LoRA. Here every job lists its own LoRAs to show the forms; to share LoRAs across jobs put `loras` in `defaults` - see configs/full.json.

jobs._note: The full form: name, scale and trigger. `trigger` words are put in front of the prompt. A built-in LoRA already knows its trigger; give one here to use other words, or "" to add none. For your own LoRA (a file in models/loras/ or an address) this is where its trigger goes.

jobs.prompt: A quiet neighborhood cafe at dawn, warm light through tall windows, steam rising from a cup on a wooden counter.

jobs._note: Several LoRAs are applied in order. A LoRA must be for the same engine as the model.
